scope: Application, Prompt15 generation/orchestration, map delivery, compatibility boundaries and repository integration.

findings.title: 명령 실패의 재시도가 30일 턴 진행을 요청함
findings.trigger: 행동 등록·취소·undo·redo가 실패하면 턴 실패와 같은 상태가 된다. Retry는 실패한 명령 대신 마지막 시간 진행을 실행하며 기본값은 30일이다.
findings.impact: 등록 실패 직후 Retry에서 queue 재전송 없이 prepare-turn(targetDate=2020-01-31)이 요청되는 것을 확인했다. 성공할 경우 의도하지 않은 시뮬레이션과 모델 요청으로 이어질 수 있다.
findings.recommendation: 명령 오류와 턴 오류를 분리하고 실제 실패 작업을 기록한다. 명령별 Retry를 제공하거나 해당 오류에는 턴 Retry를 노출하지 않는다.

sourceEvidence.title: Retry of a command failure advances time instead of retrying the command
sourceEvidence.trigger: Queue, cancel, undo or redo fails through HTTP/network/stale-state error; reconciliation read succeeds; user clicks the displayed Retry.
sourceEvidence.impact: command() writes the same failed turn phase as run(), while retry always calls run(last.current), initially a month. An action-registration or undo retry therefore sends prepare-turn and may advance the simulation with unrelated queued actions, bypassing the normal start-confirmation guards.
sourceEvidence.evidence: Direct UI/controller call-chain inspection; audit_runtime independently confirmed the same behavior.
sourceEvidence.suggestion: Separate command errors from failed turn state or retain the actual failed operation and expose operation-specific retry.
sourceEvidence.verificationSuggested: Reject a queue request, allow read reconciliation, invoke retry, and assert that prepare-turn/turn are not sent.

findings.title: 열린 국가가 병합·해산되면 패널 렌더가 예외를 냄
findings.trigger: 국가·외교 패널이 열린 상태에서 그 국가가 활성 목록에서 사라지면, projection이 없는 국가를 읽는다. 닫는 useEffect보다 렌더가 먼저 실행된다.
findings.impact: 실제 GameScreenContent에 BBB 패널을 열고 국가가 사라진 UI world로 갱신했을 때 Country view target is not active: BBB 예외를 확인했다. 전체 병합 턴의 브라우저 E2E를 실행한 것은 아니다.
findings.recommendation: 렌더 시점에 활성 대상 여부를 먼저 확인해 안전한 overlay를 계산한다. effect는 저장된 선택 상태를 정리하는 보조 역할로 둔다.

sourceEvidence.title: Retiring an open country/diplomacy target can crash before overlay reconciliation
sourceEvidence.trigger: A country panel or diplomacy target is open while a valid merge/dissolution removes that country. The picker/map remains interactive while a turn streams, so a target can be open at commit time.
sourceEvidence.impact: The new world is rendered with the old overlay ID. createCountryViewProjection/createCountrySummaryProjection throws for the inactive country. The reconcile-active-countries useEffect only runs after a successful render, so it cannot prevent this render-time crash.
sourceEvidence.evidence: Active OperationalGameSetupShell directly mounts the shared GameScreenContent; retirement effects are supported in createCatalogTurnPlan. Existing UI tests check retired options but do not cover an already-open overlay during a world transition.
sourceEvidence.suggestion: Derive an active overlay target synchronously before constructing projections; keep the effect only to normalize persistent overlay state. Use the current simulation's active player during lifecycle transitions as well.
sourceEvidence.verificationSuggested: Render GameScreenContent, open BBB country/diplomacy overlay, rerender with a valid world where BBB is absorbed, and assert a closed/fallback panel without an exception.

findings.title: 33개 대기 행동은 허용되지만 정상 턴 결과를 만들 수 없음
findings.trigger: 대기열과 context는 128개까지 허용한다. 턴 결과는 최대 32개이며, semantic validator는 모든 대기 행동에 결과 하나씩을 요구한다.
findings.impact: 작은 실제 V3 runtime에서 33개 등록 성공을 확인했다. 33개 결과는 스키마에서 거부되고, 32개 이하 결과로는 모든 행동을 처리할 수 없다. 사용자가 취소해 수를 줄이기 전에는 정상 판정이 불가능하다.
findings.recommendation: UI·서버·context·결과 계약에 공유 상한을 사용하거나 명시적인 배치 처리 정책을 도입한다.

sourceEvidence.title: 33 queued actions cannot produce any valid turn resolution
sourceEvidence.trigger: Queue 33 distinct short actions before advancing a normal live game. Queue state and context permit up to 128; the UI does not apply a 32-action cap.
sourceEvidence.impact: The provider must return one outcome for every pending action, but the resolution schema permits only 32 outcomes. Returning 33 fails schema parsing; returning at most 32 fails semantic validation. No legal turn exists until the user cancels actions, so a normal accepted queue can send the model through repairs and terminate as a provider error.
sourceEvidence.recommendation: Use one shared pending-action/outcome capacity in queue, UI, context and turn schema, or explicitly adjudicate a selected bounded batch while preserving the remainder.
sourceEvidence.proposedReproduction: With a tiny V3 catalog/runtime, queue 33 actions, construct one resolution with 33 matching outcomes and another with 32. Assert the first fails parseTurnResolutionV1 and the second fails validateTurnResolution with ACTION_OUTCOME_MISMATCH. No external AI request is required.
sourceEvidence.counterevidenceChecked: Existing schema limits and all live queue entry points were inspected; no current count guard or per-turn batching exists. This is independent of the 128-entry historical retention problem.

findings.title: 취소·처리한 기록도 쌓여 129번째 행동을 막음
findings.trigger: queuedActions 전체가 max(128)인데 취소는 status만 바꾸고 턴 처리도 이전 기록을 남긴다. 화면에서는 완료·취소 항목을 숨길 뿐이다.
findings.impact: 128회 등록·취소 후 보이는 대기 행동은 0개지만 129번째 등록이 실패했다. 새 게임 시작 외에 현재 노출된 이력 정리 경로가 없다.
findings.recommendation: 활성 대기열과 종료된 행동 이력을 분리한다. 사건·회고·재생과 참조를 고려한 보존 정책을 먼저 정하고 단순 무작정 삭제는 피한다.

sourceEvidence.title: Resolved and cancelled queue entries permanently consume a 128-action lifetime allowance
sourceEvidence.trigger: Queue and cancel 128 actions over time, leaving zero pending actions, then queue one more. Completed turn outcomes have the same retention behavior.
sourceEvidence.impact: queuePlayerAction appends all previous entries, cancel only changes status, and committed outcomes are mapped to resolved without removing old entries. Simulation V2 inherits queuedActions.max(128), so action 129 fails state construction even though the visible queue is empty. There is no current compaction or archive path; restart resets the entire game.
sourceEvidence.recommendation: Separate pending actions from terminal-action history, or compact terminal entries according to a documented replay/causality retention policy. Apply capacity to actionable entries and expose a deliberate full-queue error.
sourceEvidence.proposedReproduction: Use createWorldV3SyntheticFixture, createWorldStateV3, createInitialSimulationState, createSimulationStateV2 and createCatalogRuntime. Loop runtime.replacePendingActions(queuePlayerAction(...)) followed by cancelQueuedPlayerAction for 128 distinct IDs; the 129th replacePendingActions rejects while pending count is zero.
sourceEvidence.counterevidenceChecked: useOperationalTurnController filters resolved/cancelled entries only for display, not storage. An earlier suggestion that trimming queue entries necessarily violates existing invariant cause-ID checks was corrected: the current invariant does not validate event.causes. Event/fact/authority archive design still needs deliberate treatment.

findings.title: 초기화 실패 때 생성된 서버 게임을 닫지 않음
findings.trigger: start와 셀 자료를 Promise.all로 요청한다. start 성공 후 셀 요청·identity 확인·클라이언트 생성이 실패하면 만들어진 세션을 닫지 않는다.
findings.impact: start 성공과 cells 503을 실제 SetupShell에 주입한 뒤 오류 표시·unmount까지 DELETE가 0회임을 확인했다. 서버의 게임 한도 8개와 idle 6시간 정책 때문에 반복 실패가 새 게임 시작을 막을 수 있다.
findings.recommendation: 초기화 중 할당된 세션을 추적하고 실패·취소·unmount에서도 정리한다. 병렬 실패 이후 늦게 도착한 start 응답도 처리한다.

sourceEvidence.title: Failed bootstrap leaks a server game and can exhaust the eight-game limit
sourceEvidence.trigger: The start request creates a session, but the parallel cells request rejects, the catalog identity/client construction fails, or the component disappears before becoming ready.
sourceEvidence.impact: Only the loading promise is reset. No DELETE is sent for the allocated session and the ready-client pagehide cleanup is never installed. Eight such failures leave TOO_MANY_LOCAL_GAMES until six-hour idle expiry or server restart, while retaining full world runtimes.
sourceEvidence.evidence: Direct control-flow inspection; runtime reviewer independently identified the same lifecycle gap.
sourceEvidence.suggestion: Track the allocated session through initialization and close it on all failure/disposal paths, including a start response arriving after the parallel request has failed.
sourceEvidence.verificationSuggested: Mock successful start plus rejected cells fetch, then assert DELETE of the created session; also cover disposal before successful bootstrap.

findings.title: 한 번의 상세 지도 요청 실패가 지도 오류 화면을 고정함
findings.trigger: 정밀 국가 상세 요청 오류는 지도 전체 status를 error로 바꾼다. 재요청이 성공해도 ready로 돌리는 경로가 없고 초기 once(idle)만 ready를 설정한다.
findings.impact: ready 변경으로 상세 효과가 재실행될 수 있지만 성공 시 복귀가 없다. 현재 client 수명 동안 초기화 effect도 재실행되지 않아 새로고침 안내가 계속 남는다.
findings.recommendation: 기본 지도 상태와 선택 상세 상태를 분리한다. 상세 성공 시 오류를 해제하고, 세계 갱신 실패에는 명시적 resync/Retry 경로를 둔다.

sourceEvidence.title: A single detail-request failure permanently leaves the map error overlay
sourceEvidence.trigger: After the initial idle has made the map ready, a selected country's optional exact-detail fetch fails once.
sourceEvidence.impact: The catch sets the entire map status to error. Changing ready to false retriggers the detail effect, but even a successful retry never sets ready again: the only ready setter is the initial once-idle callback. The blocking overlay persists and asks for refresh, which discards this in-memory game.
sourceEvidence.evidence: All status transitions and detail-effect dependencies inspected. The lower-level consumer supports retry after geometry-read failure, but the host does not expose recovery or restore ready state.
sourceEvidence.suggestion: Separate optional-detail status from base-map readiness and make successful retry restore it. Add explicit retry/resync for authoritative update failures rather than relying on a full-page refresh.
sourceEvidence.verificationSuggested: Mock showCountryDetail to reject once and then resolve; verify that the map returns to ready and the game session is retained.

findings.title: 검증자가 반환한 운영 실패는 acknowledge 후 재개할 수 없음
findings.trigger: afterVerification의 operating 분기는 operatingIncident.resumePhase를 만들지 않는다. CLI resume --ack-operating는 그 값을 필수로 요구한다.
findings.impact: 순수 함수 재현에서 operating_failure를 만든 뒤 acknowledgeOperatingFailure가 Operating incident has no safe resume phase로 실패했다. 증거 인증 불일치도 같은 경로로 들어간다.
findings.recommendation: 예외로 들어온 운영 실패와 같은 incident 생성기를 사용해 verify 복귀 위치를 저장하고 두 실패 진입점을 모두 검사한다.

sourceEvidence.title: Verifier-originated operating failures cannot be acknowledged and resumed
sourceEvidence.trigger: Verifier reports failureKind=operating, or validateVerification converts inconsistent/missing evidence into an operating failure.
sourceEvidence.impact: afterVerification sets status and phase to operating_failure but creates no operatingIncident.resumePhase. The documented resume --ack-operating path calls acknowledgeOperatingFailure, which throws Operating incident has no safe resume phase. The run cannot recover through the exposed CLI after the cause is fixed.
sourceEvidence.evidence: The exception path uses operatingFailure(), which does preserve resumePhase; the verifier-return path does not. Existing integration tests cover acknowledgement of an exception-generated incident and separately test evidence mismatch stops, but never acknowledge that mismatch state.
sourceEvidence.suggestion: Route verifier operating failures through the same incident constructor with resumePhase=verify and authenticated evidence identity, and cover acknowledgement/resume of verifier-return and evidence-authentication failures.
sourceEvidence.reproduction: Pure-function reproduction: create initialState with phase=verify, call afterVerification with verdict=fail/failureKind=operating, then acknowledgeOperatingFailure on the result. No fixture or agent process is necessary. Parent handles execution.

findings.title: 외부 입력 보완 후 waiting_input에서 재개하는 전이가 없음
findings.trigger: 구현자 external_input 또는 검증자 external 실패는 waiting_input을 만든다. 이 상태는 terminal이며 run은 즉시 반환하고 resume CLI에도 복귀 전이가 없다.
findings.impact: 명시적으로 입력을 보완해 resume을 실행해도 모델 턴이 재개되지 않는 제어 흐름이다. 실제 작업 세션이나 외부 모델을 실행하지 않고 상태 전이와 CLI를 확인했다.
findings.recommendation: 사람의 입력 보완 확인을 받는 명시적 전이를 추가해 phase·attempt·history를 보존하고 필요한 입력 identity를 다시 확인한다.

sourceEvidence.title: The exposed resume command has no transition out of waiting_input
sourceEvidence.trigger: Implementer returns external_input or verifier returns failureKind=external; a human supplies the missing input and invokes prompt15:resume.
sourceEvidence.impact: waiting_input is terminal, run() returns it unchanged before evaluating stop signals, and resume only handles operating_failure acknowledgement. No CLI command transitions waiting_input back to its implement/verify phase. Restarting a new run or editing state manually is required instead of resuming the saved attempt.
sourceEvidence.suggestion: Provide an explicit human-triggered input acknowledgement transition that preserves phase/attempt/history, validates updated input identities as appropriate and clears requiredInput only after acknowledgement. Add coverage for both implement and verify waiting states.
sourceEvidence.reproduction: Parent can construct a runtime with state.status=waiting_input and a counting fake clientFactory, call run(), and observe unchanged status and zero client calls. No active model/session required.

findings.title: 턴 타임아웃에서 종료 확인 interval이 남음
findings.trigger: 타임아웃 경로가 active turn을 Map에서 지우면서 stopTimer를 해제하지 않는다. 이후 fail도 이미 지워진 항목을 찾지 못한다.
findings.impact: Codex 프로세스를 띄우지 않은 fake client와 fake timer로 TURN_TIMEOUT 뒤 turns.size=0인데 timer 1개가 남는 것을 재현했다. 실제 컨트롤러 프로세스 종료를 지연시킬 수 있다.
findings.recommendation: 모든 종료 경로가 timeout·interval을 함께 해제하는 공통 finalize 함수를 사용하게 한다.

sourceEvidence.title: A model turn timeout leaks its stop polling interval
sourceEvidence.trigger: runTurn reaches turnTimeoutMs (configured one hour by default).
sourceEvidence.impact: The timeout deletes the active turn from this.turns and rejects completion without clearing active.stopTimer. Subsequent fail()/close() can no longer find that turn. The one-second interval remains referenced and can keep the controller process alive after it reports operating_failure.
sourceEvidence.evidence: Completion, stop and turn/start failure branches clear the interval; the timeout branch alone omits it. There is no CodexClient timer lifecycle test in the current orchestrator tests.
sourceEvidence.suggestion: Use a common turn-finalization helper that clears both timers before removing the turn in every terminal path.
sourceEvidence.reproduction: Parent can construct Object.create(CodexClient.prototype) with request stub and turnTimeoutMs=10, track setInterval/clearInterval calls, and observe one active interval after TURN_TIMEOUT. Explicitly clear the captured interval at the end so the diagnostic process exits. No Codex process or network is necessary.

findings.title: 배포 추적 설정이 현재 필수 승인 파일까지 제외함
findings.trigger: Linux/POSIX의 파일 추적 기반 배포에서 reports/prompt15/**/* 제외 규칙을 적용할 때.
findings.impact: 현재 loader는 해당 경로의 admission/verdict 두 파일을 반드시 읽는다. 두 파일이 제외 glob에 매칭됨을 재현했다. 전체 checkout을 유지하는 로컬 next start와 같은 조건은 아니며, 실제 배포 빌드/컨테이너를 실행하지는 않았다.
findings.recommendation: 현재 runtime admission·verdict를 data/runtime 같은 명확한 런타임 위치로 옮기거나 archive 제외 범위를 좁힌다. Next 설치 구현은 include 뒤 exclude를 적용하므로 같은 경로를 include에만 추가하는 것으로 충분하다고 가정하지 않는다.

sourceEvidence.probe: on a POSIX traced deployment the Next exclusion matches both mandatory operational admission files

findings.title: 과거 복구 CLI 5개가 삭제된 API를 참조함
findings.trigger: 다섯 복구 명령이 protocol.mjs에 없는 atomicJSON/validateIdentities를 import한다. 둘은 없어진 product-target.mjs/app-server.mjs도 참조한다.
findings.impact: 현재 package의 주 명령은 새 run.mjs를 쓰므로 일반 게임 장애는 아니다. 남아 있는 과거 명령을 실행하면 인자 검증 전 모듈 연결 단계에서 실패한다.
findings.recommendation: 현재 지원하지 않는 과거 복구 명령을 명시적으로 archive/폐기한다. 구형 state 모델까지 기대하므로 export alias만 되살리지 않는다.

sourceEvidence.title: Five historical repair CLIs still import removed v1 controller APIs
sourceEvidence.trigger: A maintainer imports/runs one of the old reconciliation or restoration commands left in scripts/.
sourceEvidence.impact: All five named-import atomicJSON and validateIdentities, which protocol.mjs no longer exports. Two additionally reference absent product-target.mjs/app-server.mjs. They fail during module linking before validating arguments or reading historical state. Current package commands use the new run.mjs, so this is a broken historical entrypoint problem, not a gameplay failure.
sourceEvidence.suggestion: Archive/mark these commands as historical or remove the obsolete entrypoints after deciding retention. Do not reintroduce compatibility aliases blindly because they also expect the old multi-task state model.
sourceEvidence.reproduction: A read-only dynamic import of prompt15-prepare-15-18-resume.mjs fails at ESM named-export linking before its guarded CLI body. Parent may execute if needed.

findings.title: 수치 실패 증거의 before와 after가 같은 변경 후 값임
findings.trigger: Common noding 실패 증거에서 beforeExactNumerator와 afterExactNumerator 모두 coordinates로 계산한다. 실제 이전 ring은 data.ring이다.
findings.impact: 판정 자체는 여전히 실패하므로 허위 PASS 문제는 아니다. 다만 원인 조사에 쓰는 before/after 정밀 면적 증거가 잘못된다.
findings.recommendation: before는 data.ring, after는 coordinates에서 계산하고 서로 다른 값이 들어가는 실패 fixture를 둔다.

sourceEvidence.title: The numerical failure evidence writes the post-noding numerator into both before and after fields
sourceEvidence.trigger: Common noding changes the exact ring sign and the diagnostic error is emitted.
sourceEvidence.impact: beforeExactNumerator and afterExactNumerator both call exactRingNumerator(coordinates), even though beforeRing is data.ring. The rejection remains correct, but its before/after exact-area evidence is contradictory and misleads analysis of the numerical failures.
sourceEvidence.suggestion: Compute the before value from data.ring and the after value from coordinates, with a fixture asserting both identities. This does not require reopening any deferred country audit.

architectureRisks.title: Sparse territorial turns still copy, scan and hash the complete 923,443-cell lookup, while undo history retains every full lookup
architectureRisks.confirmedStructure: Each territory-changing effect spreads the complete territoriesById record. Render delta generation enumerates all cells. Runtime root hashing caches unchanged leaf SHA values but enumerates all leaves and rebuilds/sorts/serializes the complete root for each new record. Atomic turn history retains before/after worlds and plans without a length cap. The session versions map limit of 64 is separate and does not limit engine history.
architectureRisks.risk: Work is not bounded by the 512 changed-cell cap; repeated territorial turns cause growing retained full lookup maps and repeated O(N) or O(N log N) work. No exact latency, memory amount, or OOM threshold was measured in this review.
architectureRisks.recommendation: Use persistent/chunked ownership/control storage, preserve changed-cell sets for delta generation, implement incremental domain roots and choose a bounded/checkpointed undo policy. Add a many-turn 923k-cell performance regression, not only a small synthetic correctness test.
architectureRisks.testLimit: prompt14-performance.test uses the previous 4,231-cell catalog; task16-09 records two scripted occupation turns, not long-session resource verification.

architectureRisks.title: Other capped state collections also accumulate terminal history
architectureRisks.confirmedStructure: eventLog is capped at 2,048 and every turn appends all new/host events; factOrder is capped at 512, situationOrder and scheduledConsequences at 256, while ended/resolved records are retained. No archival/retention path is present in the live runtime.
architectureRisks.risk: After a long enough game, adding otherwise-valid events or new narrative records fails state parsing and prevents that turn from committing. This is related to historical retention design but separate from pending outcome capacity and from full-map memory growth.
architectureRisks.recommendation: Define a consistent active/history retention model. Trimming events blindly is unsafe because facts, situations and authorities require their referenced source event IDs to remain resolvable.

additionalDebt.finding: Raw min/max longitude bounds produce global zoom for antimeridian countries. Read-only metadata calculation gives FJI bounds[-180,-21.711114,180,-12.475274] and zoom1; KIR/RUS/USA also zoom1. nearestWrappedLongitude only fixes center wrapping. The older catalog projection repeats this pattern, so it is inherited shared debt, not a new Prompt16-only regression.

One changed cell loads/parses/validates its entire source country's exact GeoJSON before filtering. Actual gzip trailer sizes: RUS29.375MiB decoded, USA16.243MiB, CAN17.027MiB. The byte LRU does not cache parsed geometry and competing edge/detail reads may evict country bytes. Treat as an optimization target, not measured latency or a proven memory failure.

visibleCells actually accumulates every observed tile cell for the client's lifetime. Hover/selection iterate this accumulated set, and delivery seenCells/seenEdges are outside the32MiB byte LRU. Growth is bounded by the full catalog, not the viewport; performance impact needs a panning/long-session measurement.

The operational shell imports shared GameScreenContent from a module that also imports the old CatalogWorldMap/controller. Split the shared presentation from the legacy host to make dependencies clearer; bundle inclusion is not claimed without build evidence.

cleanupCandidates.description: 깨진 과거 복구 명령 5개와 지원 종료 상태를 한곳에 정리한다.
현재 실행·script·test import를 찾지 못했다. Prompt01 문서와 과거 checkpoint의 해시 기록만 남아 있다. ID 정규화 정책을 확인한 뒤 제거 후보로 삼는다.
공유 GameScreenContent와 turn-controller interface를 legacy host에서 분리하고, legacy/regression 진입점과 현재 진입점을 명시한다.
일부 스냅샷 코드는 독립 실행 가능한 프로젝트가 아니며 현재 없는 import를 포함한다. 현재 소스와 혼동되지 않도록 archive 문서/확장자/검사 범위를 명시한다.
현재 운영 V3 엔진을 test-only로 설명하는 이전 단계 주석을 현행 구조에 맞춘다.

withheld.finding: The module-level client survives route remounts, but initialized is a local ref. If /game -> / remounts the page, restart is skipped, so a new country selection continues the old game or fails fresh-seed validation. Requires an actual route/remount reproduction before promoting to a finding.

runtime.notExhaustive: Every legacy V2 command/planner and all broad world hashing/topology utility tests were not read line by line. Parent import-graph/static checks and other audit agents cover integration/config/map/API and Prompt15 generators. No app/source edits, runtime tests, external model calls or fixture generation were performed by this agent.

mapUi.limitations: Legacy WorldMap/CatalogWorldMap, glyph-generation math and tests were sampled for comparison; not every old renderer or every game component line was manually audited. No server, browser, external AI call or test execution was performed by this agent.

directReview: current orchestration config, verifier prompt and task plan
world-catalog, world-preflight, world-indices and world-delivery entry contracts
representative r3 run wrappers and current shared r3 imports
pipeline.limitations: This is not a claim that every line of all geometry/sliver implementations or every node-test was exhaustively reviewed. Current-source dependency and entrypoint inspection plus selected deeper control-flow audits were performed. Parent owns runtime/map audits and test execution.

coverage.limitation: The repository-wide static graph/search/lint/typecheck were combined with deep reviews of critical execution paths; not every line of all historical math/geometry implementations was manually audited.

auditProbes.meaning: These temporary probes pass when the currently suspected defect is observed; they are diagnostic evidence, not regression tests asserting corrected behavior.

notRun: Full production build or deployment package
Browser E2E / actual Next navigation remount
External AI API or live Codex/Discord automation
Whole Prompt15 regeneration, historical world audit or all node-test.mjs suites

preserve: World V3 + Simulation V2 version combination is intentional.
Current r3-input and r3-edge-noding helpers are imported by current generation code.
Old WorldMap/CatalogWorldMap, region provider and V1 APIs remain used by compatibility and E2E aliases.
country-label-worker-protocol is read by a benchmark as deferred worker preparation; lack of imports is not proof it is unused.
fontkit.d.ts is an ambient TypeScript declaration; react-dom is a Next/React runtime dependency, not removable based on zero direct imports.
Existing missing V18/V19 gate files, deferred countries and reload-starts-new-game policy are preexisting scope facts, not new failures attributed to this cleanup.
